title: Radiant Nuclear hero
description: A window-high photo hero (capped at 1100px) with a black-to-clear gradient rising from the bottom. Everything sits low: a big bold all-caps headline, a one-line pipe-separated subline, a flat translucent button (right-aligned on phones), and a line of fine print under it.
notes: sized by the window (100svh, at most 1100px); the photo is cropped to it like object-fit: cover
type is set in the theme's card colour over a foreground gradient (foreground over a background gradient in dark mode), so it needs a theme whose foreground and card contrast
pairs with radiantnuclear-header, which floats over it
